name: Cinemas and theatres
shape_facts: Number of screens or stages and seats per hall.
Independent single-screen, small multiplex, or theatre/auditorium hosting productions and hires.
Mix of revenue: tickets, concessions (food and drinks), advertising, private screenings, hall rentals.
Ticketing: counter only, own website, or third-party apps.
Owned building, mall lease or rented auditorium.
Content: local films, Bollywood (where permitted), Hollywood, regional, stage plays, comedy shows, concerts.
Staff structure: box office, ushers, projectionist/technician, concession team.
scope_rule: pi notes operational and business problems: occupancy by show, ticketing and box-office cash, concession wastage and theft, film scheduling, projection and sound downtime, distributor settlements and audience communication. pi does not advise on censorship or content classification, distribution contracts, entertainment taxes, fire codes, crowd safety or licensing; it records only the business friction. pi never collects audience members’ names, contact details or card data, and records roles only.

vocabulary.occupancy: share of seats filled in a show
vocabulary.DCP: digital cinema package, the digital film file
vocabulary.KDM: key that unlocks a film for screening on set dates
vocabulary.distributor share: percentage of ticket revenue paid to the distributor
vocabulary.hall hire: renting the auditorium for a private event

problems.phrase: Weekday afternoon shows run nearly empty
I don’t know which shows actually cover their costs
Box office cash doesn’t match ticket counts
Complimentary tickets are given out too freely by staff
Popcorn and drinks stock doesn’t match sales
Concession staff give free food to friends
Popcorn and hot food thrown away every night

Customers call asking showtimes all day
Our website showtimes are often wrong
Big releases sell out and smaller films die, and I can’t plan screens well
Reviews complain about dirty halls and broken seats
Ushers don’t clean between shows fast enough
We have no idea who our regulars are
Social posts about new films go up late or not at all
Mall rent and electricity have gone up but ticket prices can’t

Theatre productions renting our hall pay late

occupancy: How do you decide the show schedule each week?
box office: How are tickets sold, counter or apps?
How is cash checked at the end of the day?
complimentary and refunds: Who can give a free ticket?
audience: How do people find your showtimes?
branches: How do you compare locations today?

seasons: PK: Eid ul Fitr and Eid ul Adha are the biggest release windows for local films; winter holidays and summer vacations; Ramadan and Muharram are very slow; Pakistani dramas and stage shows peak around Eid and winter; cricket tournaments pull audiences away. UAE: Eid, school holidays, summer (indoor entertainment), Hollywood blockbuster summer and December slates, Diwali-period Indian releases; Ramadan slower until late night. Canada: summer blockbusters, December holidays, March break; theatre seasons usually autumn to spring; South Asian releases around Eid and Diwali in large cities.
care: Fire, crowd crush, medical emergency in the hall, or a security threat: pi stops and points to emergency services immediately.
No advice on censorship, content approvals, distribution contracts or entertainment tax; these are noted as admin effort only.
pi does not help with piracy, unlicensed screenings or hiding ticket sales from distributors or tax authorities.
Audience personal data and card details are never collected.
Covert recording of staff in private areas is out of bounds.
build_ideas: Daily box-office and concessions summary to the owner: tickets by show, occupancy, comps, refunds, concession sales.
Reconciliation view matching counter sales, ticketing app sales and cash/card totals.
Complimentary and refund approval flow with reasons logged.
Concession stock tracker with opening/closing counts per shift and wastage log.
Show-level profit view: ticket revenue minus distributor share, plus concessions attributed.
Distributor settlement statement generator per film per week.
Equipment maintenance log for projectors and sound with downtime record.
WhatsApp showtime assistant answering “what’s on tonight” from the schedule.
Hall hire booking calendar with deposits and balances.
